How it's calculated

Profit = AH sale price − reagents (no AH cut by default; set it in Settings), per item crafted. Vials at vendor price. Forever recipes from Wowhead (Nov 9, 2026). Dot: chance of a skill-up. “CD”: cooldown.

How the guide is built

Two modes. Profitable crafts: for every skill point the guide picks the recipe with the best expected result per point, reagents (cheapest of AH or vendor) minus what the crafted items resell for on the AH; items with fewer than 3 listed count as unsellable. Safe skill-ups: it picks the recipe with the highest skill-up chance (orange first), then the best result, to level with the fewest crafts. Expected crafts follow the classic odds: 100% while orange, then (grey − skill) / (grey − yellow). Profit / loss per step = AH resale value − reagents: an estimate, selling many units can push prices down. Recipes with a missing reagent price, cooldowns and recipes above your skill are skipped. Remember to train the next rank at 75, 150 and 225.

How plans are calculated

Daily sales volume is estimated from your AH scans (or the chosen assumption when there is no history). A plan only targets part of it so prices don't crash, uses only part of the reagent supply and spreads the budget according to the profile. Gains remain estimates.

My vendor run

Before you buy

Catalogue: every item sold for gold by WoW Forever vendors (Wowhead) that can go on the AH; bind-on-pickup items are excluded. Vendor prices without reputation discount. Vendors and coordinates (x / y on the zone map) from Wowhead; choose your faction to only see vendors who will sell to you. An item “not on the AH” has no known price: no competition, but no reference price either. Profit = lowest AH price − AH cut (5%) − vendor price. Big gaps often come from limited-stock vendors (a few units restocking over time) or faction/reputation items: check in game before investing. The AH deposit is lost if the item doesn't sell, and flooding a 3-listing market will quickly drop the price.

About this list

Every recipe of the profession on WoW Forever, from Wowhead. Vendor recipes show the vendors of your faction (or neutral), their zone and map coordinates, and the vendor price; some are limited stock or need reputation. Drop and quest recipes show the recipe's AH price when one is listed. Trainer recipes are learned from any trainer of the profession once you reach the skill (and the rank).

Sales history

How sales are estimated

The game doesn't publish sales. When an item has fewer units listed than in the previous AH scan, the difference counts as sold (cancellations and expirations included). A ballpark figure, more accurate with frequent AH scans. The history updates on every price fetch (button or the automatic check every 10 minutes, even while the page is in the background). Blizzard publishes new auction data about once an hour: a check that returns the same data adds no scan.

At least two AH scans are needed: fetch prices again later.

Price source

Create a client on develop.battle.net (Blizzard Developer Portal → API Access), then paste the ID and secret. They stay in this browser. If the call is blocked, paste an access token directly.

Cloud history (GitHub)

A GitHub Actions job scans the auction house every hour, even when your PC is off. Paste the address of its data below: the Grimoire merges the missing scans and the latest prices every time it opens (and every 20 min).

Auctionator scan

After a full in-game scan and a /reload, pick the Auctionator.lua file in _forever_\WTF\Account\…\SavedVariables.

API JSON

Paste the JSON response from the endpoint /data/wow/connected-realm/{id}/auctions/{ahId}, or pick the saved file.
